_what_this_is: ⛔ A HAND-AUTHORED SEED, NOT AN EMPIRICAL HISTOGRAM. Every other scene's tree-mix.json is the output of scripts/15-derive-tree-mix.py counting a real municipal census. Huron has no municipal census, and its 168 OSM trees carry ZERO species tags (measured 2026-09-20), so there is nothing to count. These weights are a judgement about a real place, authored per TREE-INTAKE.md §5.4 and approved by Jacob 2026-09-20. ⛔ Do not re-derive this file from huron's census — the census cannot produce it, and running scripts/15 here would overwrite judgement with an empty count.
source: HAND-AUTHORED SEED (no municipal census) — Huron, Erie County, Ohio
_liveTrees_why: 0 is honest, not a failure: liveTrees counts census points carrying a REAL species, and huron has none. 168 OSM points exist but are speciesless; they get draped from the weights below, which makes them mix-sampled, never observed.

_sources.what: City of Huron Codified Ordinances, Planning & Zoning Ch. 1131.03(a),(d)
_sources.⛔: Huron has NO approved street-tree species list. Ch. 1131 names no species at all, approved or prohibited. It is criteria-based: 'The use of native species is encouraged… All trees and vegetation planted shall be common to northern Ohio or similar climates' (a), plus drought-tolerance (d). TREE-INTAKE §5.4's first input does not exist for this town; that absence is recorded here rather than papered over with another city's list.

_sources.⭐: Verified BY COORDINATE (41.3885, -82.5568 — ~1 km from this scene's geography.json center), not by name. ⛔ Huron city is in ERIE County, Ohio — not Huron County, and not Huron City, Michigan. Both false matches were hit and discarded during this authoring; so was 'Urban Forestry in Erie County' (releaferie.org), which is Erie County NEW YORK.

_excluded_deliberately.Pyrus calleryana: ⛔ ILLEGAL IN OHIO. Sale, growth and planting prohibited since 2023-01-01 (Ohio Admin. Code 901:5-30-01; Ohio was the first state to ban it). ⚠️ This is a JURISDICTION fact, not a taste: it is true of every Ohio town forever, and arborist/dossiers/pyrus_calleryana.json exists, so the species is one Salon composition away from being routable here. There is no 'prohibited in this jurisdiction' state in grove-eligibility.mjs today — `withheld` means 'we have one and judge it not good enough', which is a different claim. Until that exists, this comment is the only thing standing between an Ohio town and a legal street tree. ⭐ Hi-Pointe/DeMun plants 306 of them and is RIGHT to.
_excluded_deliberately._not_excluded_ash: ⭐ Fraxinus is IN, at weight 4. EAB is established in Ohio (since 2003) and has killed most mature ash, but Ohio towns genuinely still carry ash — standing dead, declining, and heavy young regrowth. Excluding it was proposed and OVERRULED by Jacob 2026-09-20: if it is in the town, it is in the mix. A census-observed ash is honoured by scripts/15's 'City points keep their REAL species' rule regardless of this file.

_weights_are_demand: ⭐ THESE WEIGHTS ARE A DEMAND SIGNAL, NOT A SHIPPING LIST. roster-coverage.js reads every census well, so once these names are draped onto huron's points they become counts, and resolveGrove (arborist/grove-eligibility.mjs) ranks the whole board by them — including species with no composition, because 'a red row at rank 3 is the loudest thing on the board'. ⛔ So this mix deliberately names trees Huron SHOULD have and the Grove cannot yet ship. That is not a defect to prune; it is what gives the operator an ordered queue in the Salon. Shrinking this list to what is already composed was proposed and rejected the same day — it would have deleted the work queue.

_state_of_each.⛔: These three lists are a SNAPSHOT for the reader, not a source of truth. The live answer is computed by roster-coverage.js + grove-eligibility.mjs on every read, and it changes the moment an operator composes something. Do not consume this field in code.
_state_of_each.⭐ Quercus bicolor is the one worth harve: Swamp white oak is THE lakeplain street tree for this soil and this shoreline, and it is the only entry here with neither a composition nor a dossier.

_unmapped_is_deliberate: ⛔ THE NINE UNMAPPED NAMES ARE NOT AN OVERSIGHT. A COMMON with no entry here falls through to bake-trees#pickVariant's CATEGORY_FALLBACK — the sanctioned substitution ('substitution is the safety net; authored trees are the visible product', ARCHITECTURE.md) — and CoverageView shows it as 🔴 gap, the shopping list. ⭐ The alternative, routing them at ids nothing answers to, produces the IDENTICAL bake but reads as ⚠ dangling: LS's map points 49 roster names at procedural_* ids that can no longer ship. An unmapped name is an honest gap; a dangling route is a gap wearing a routing's clothes. ⛔ Map a name here only when a composition exists for it.
_palette_why_renormalised: ⛔ DERIVED, never hand-written: share = this species' weight ÷ the MAPPED weight total (64 of 100), so the palette cannot drift from commonWeights.
